_comment: Curated dish sequences. Each dish keeps its own destinationId, so a trail can span more than one place without the trail entity needing to say so twice.

name: Ima Keithel Morning Food Trail
description: A walk through the women's market before the midday crowds, stopping for a savoury snack, a condiment worth tasting in small amounts, and a sweet finish.
durationHint: 2–3 hours, on foot around the market

name: Moirang Home-Kitchen Trail
description: A full Manipuri home meal built across a household kitchen visit: a light stew, the valley's everyday comfort dish, and a squash dessert to close.
durationHint: Half a day, by arrangement with a household kitchen

name: Ukhrul Hill Kitchen Trail
description: The hill cooking of the Tangkhul households around Ukhrul, built on smoke and bamboo shoot rather than the valley's fish and rice.
